title: The Smiling House
author: Quentin Crane
blurb: Dominic Delacroix, a hospice nurse who hears the dying count backwards, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the sleep recordings capture a second voice answering questions, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
